items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There were a number of pianists playing in a sort of bluesy, soul piano style, like Wynton Kelly and Hampton Hawes

ctx.x: There’s a quote in the biography where you say the way you were playing wasn’t anything that... There were a number of pianists playing in a sort of bluesy, soul piano style, like Wynton Kelly and Hampton Hawes, and you thought you could be understood in that context. But when you started to lead groups after the Bohemia gig, and people started to take notice... There were a number of young singer-songwriters in New York at the time, all very witty, very
capable, very verbal, like Dave Frishberg, Bob Dorough...
